site.title: BJJ GYM — Academy software built on the mats
site.description: BJJ GYM runs your Jiu-Jitsu academy: members, schedule, check-ins, billing, belts, leads, staff, shop and reports in one place.

site.promo: 🥋 Built by grapplers, for academy owners
